title: Padmapani, Cave 1 at Ajanta
alt: Painted bodhisattva wearing a jewelled crown and holding a lotus, surrounded by smaller figures
caption: Later Ajanta phase, broadly fifth-sixth centuries CE. Detail of the Cave 1 mural, not a painting from the site's earliest BCE caves. Surface losses and low-light photographic grain remain visible. Image record date: 2009-07-16.

title: Nalanda: Temple 3
alt: Large stepped brick ruin surrounded by smaller brick shrine foundations
caption: Temple 3 at Nalanda, conventionally called the Sariputta Stupa. The surviving fabric belongs to successive building phases; this photograph does not date all of its brickwork to the institution's beginnings. Image record date: 2023-10-09 16:10:10.

title: Nalanda: a shrine detail at Temple 3
alt: Seated Buddha in a decorated niche on a rounded brick structure beside Temple 3
caption: Stucco and architectural detail at Temple 3. Read this alongside the wider site view; an exact date for this particular surviving surface needs an excavation or conservation reference. Image record date: 2023-10-09 12:29:53.

title: Kailasa: carved courtyard and visitors
alt: Visitors stand beside large animal carvings and excavated rock walls in the Kailasa courtyard
caption: A modern courtyard view at Kailasa, Cave 16, Ellora. Carved animals and the surrounding rock illustrate sculptural work at the site. The visitors provide visual orientation, not a measured archaeological scale. Image record date: 2007-10-17 14:07:59.

title: Shore Temple, Mahabalipuram
alt: Two stepped stone towers rise above shrines enclosed by a wall with seated bull sculptures
caption: Eighth-century Pallava structural temple at Mahabalipuram. Compare its assembled masonry with the site's rock-cut caves and monolithic rathas; these are different construction techniques. Image record date: 2006-01-29.

title: Kandariya Mahadeva Temple
alt: Tall clustered temple spires silhouetted against a golden sky above a sculpted platform
caption: Kandariya Mahadeva, within Khajuraho's principal Chandella building period, around 950-1050 CE. The photograph emphasises the rising architectural form; it is not a complete survey of the Hindu and Jain ensembles. Image record date: 2014-10-07 16:48:17.

title: Hoysaleswara Temple, Halebidu
alt: Low richly carved stone temple walls and stepped entrance under a blue sky
caption: Hoysaleswara at Halebidu, a twelfth-century Hoysala monument. This is one of three UNESCO ensembles; Belur and Somanathapura are different sites with their own building histories. Image record date: 2023-11-30 07:40:52.

title: Qutb Minar and Alai Darwaza
alt: Qutb Minar rises behind an arched gateway with carved stone and contrasting inlay
caption: Mehrauli, Delhi. The tower's early-thirteenth-century phases and the Alai Darwaza of 1311 are distinct. The present-day view also contains subsequent repairs and additions; it is not the complex as it stood in 1200. Image record date: 2025-11-01 12:44:33.

title: Konark: a carved chariot wheel
alt: Large circular stone wheel with decorated spokes set against the carved temple wall
caption: Thirteenth-century Sun Temple, Odisha. One wheel from the temple's chariot imagery. This architectural carving does not establish a claim that every wheel was a calibrated, minute-accurate clock. Image record date: 2016-08-13 17:15:32.

title: Konark: wheel-hub detail
alt: Close view of a carved stone wheel hub with small figures and patterned spokes
caption: A separate photograph of a wheel centre at Konark. Compare the carving with the wider wheel view, but do not assume these two photographs show exactly the same wheel. Image record date: 2018-09-22 16:32:47.

title: Hazara Rama Temple: narrative reliefs
alt: Two horizontal rows of stone reliefs showing seated figures, attendants and a horse-drawn chariot
caption: Hazara Rama Temple, Hampi, early fifteenth-century foundation. The temple's reliefs belong to a sacred and royal setting; this detail is not a literal record of one dated court event or proof of the construction date of every panel. Image record date: 2023-01-26 14:48:27.

credit: Classical Numismatic Group, Inc. (cngcoins.com), via Wikimedia Commons
title: Apollodotus I: bilingual coin
alt: Two faces of a round coin, with an elephant and Greek letters on one face and a bull with Kharoshthi letters on the other
caption: Indo-Greek Apollodotus I, second century BCE; attribution follows the linked CNG/Commons record. Both faces are shown. The photograph alone does not establish the mint, findspot or a territorial boundary; no unverified weight is supplied. Image record date: 2016-12-10.

credit: Classical Numismatic Group, Inc. (cngcoins.com), via Wikimedia Commons
title: Samudragupta: lyrist-type gold coin
alt: Two gold coin faces showing a seated ruler playing a stringed instrument and a seated female deity
caption: Fourth century CE; CNG/Commons dates this issue approximately 335-380 CE. The depicted instrument and royal figure express courtly identity. This is the photographed CNG specimen, not the superficially similar coin in the British Museum or Indian Museum. Image record date: 2017-07-26.

title: Nizamuddin Dargah in modern Delhi
alt: White shrine dome beside a red arcaded building, with contemporary awnings and electrical fittings
caption: Modern view of the shrine associated with Nizamuddin Auliya. The photograph locates a continuing devotional centre; its present buildings, fittings and decoration must not all be assigned to the saint's medieval lifetime. It does not illustrate every bhakti or Sufi tradition. Image record date: 2017-12-25 13:50:43.

title: Virupaksha Temple, Pattadakal
alt: Stone temple tower and pillared structures seen across a paved courtyard
caption:
Virupaksha at Pattadakal, commissioned by Queen Lokamahadevi around 740 CE. This is the Karnataka Chalukya monument, not the similarly named temple at Hampi. Modern paving and landscaping remain visible. Image record date: 1 August 2008 (original upload date)

(Original text: July 2008).

title: Rani-ki-Vav: descending architecture
alt: Deep stepped corridor with successive pillared levels and sculptural niches
caption: Eleventh-century stepwell at Patan, Gujarat. The photograph shows the conserved descent and architectural levels. It does not supply an engineering section or establish the historic water table. Image record date: 2013-11-29.

title: Thanjavur: modern sanctuary-plan illustration
alt: Black-and-white plan showing thick walls and passages around a square central shrine
caption: Modern plan illustration of the Brihadisvara sanctuary, published in 2021. No scale, north arrow or archaeological phase key is visible. Use it to discuss spatial form, not to measure dimensions or reconstruct the whole eleventh-century complex. Image record date: 2021-05-22.

credit: The original uploader was Drnsreedhar at English Wikipedia.
title: Coin attributed to Muhammad bin Tughluq
alt: Both faces of a worn inscribed coin against red fabric
caption: Attributed to Muhammad bin Tughluq by the contributor's Commons record, from a personal collection. Reign: 1325-1351 CE. Exact issue date, mint, metal, weight and catalogue accession are not verified; this is not presented as an identified silver tanka or the Smithsonian gold coin S1999.18. Image record date: 26 November 2006 (original upload date).

credit: The Metropolitan Museum of Art; Purchase, Edward J. Gallagher Jr. Bequest, in memory of his father, Edward Joseph Gallagher, his mother, Ann Hay Gallagher, and his son, Edward Joseph Gallagher III, 1982
captureDate: Museum photograph; capture date not supplied
title: Karaikkal Ammaiyar: later devotional bronze
alt: Seated slender bronze figure holding a pair of small cymbals
caption: Tamil Nadu, ca. late thirteenth century CE; copper alloy, The Met 1982.220.11. A later devotional representation of the sixth-century Shaiva poet, not a contemporary portrait. It illustrates the saint's continuing remembrance beyond this entry's composition window. Museum photograph; capture date not supplied.

credit: The Cleveland Museum of Art, Edward L. Whittemore Fund, 1941.94
captureDate: Museum photograph; capture date not supplied
title: Mathura: seated Buddha, 200s CE
alt: Headless sandstone Buddha seated cross-legged, with robe folds across the torso and a surviving hand
caption: Northern India, Mathura, Kushan period, 200s CE. Sandstone; Cleveland Museum of Art 1941.94. The head and parts of the arms are missing. Museum attribution identifies the artistic region, not a documented excavation location for this object. Museum photograph; capture date not supplied.

title: Kailasa, Ellora: exterior view
alt: Rock-cut temple tower and carved walls seen beneath an overhanging rock edge
caption: Kailasa, Cave 16, generally associated with the eighth-century Rashtrakuta phase. This exterior view shows one Hindu monument within a much larger Buddhist, Hindu and Jain site; it is not a panorama of all 34 caves. Image record date: 2008-04-03 17:20:20.

title: Brihadisvara: a living temple in 2025
alt: Illuminated temple tower and a pillared pavilion with visitors at dusk
caption: Thanjavur: the main Chola temple was built in the early eleventh century. This 2025 Maha Shivaratri view includes later structures and modern lighting. Source derivative by UnpetitproleX from Rainer Halama's photograph; no further crop or edit was made here. Image record date: 27 February 2025 19:46:55+05:30.

title: Buddha Offering Protection: profile view
alt: Side view of a standing bronze Buddha with raised hand, long robe and modern display support
caption: Late sixth-early seventh century CE; probably Bihar, The Met 69.222. A profile view of the same object as the frontal photograph. Surface colour and modern display fittings are visible; the photograph alone cannot reveal internal casting channels. Museum photograph; capture date not supplied.
